newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar extends slide as Oct expiry looms.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar extends slide as Oct expiry looms.

text.p: White sugar futures extended their earlier losses in heavy Wednesday trading as players continued to sell their spot October positions ahead of expiry.
Volume was concentrated in the two nearby positions where trading ranges were wide at $3.50.
Open interest has been rapidly increasing in both the December and March contracts as traders roll forward their October positions through switch dealings before October expires on Friday.
But with a dearth of fresh physical news, market sources said the expiry might produce some more offtake and market interest once the October deliveries were out of the way.
"London (October) expires on Friday so hopefully that might breathe a bit of life into it," said one trader.
At 1607 GMT October and December were both hovering at intraday lows, down $3.20 at $345.50 and down $3.00 at $343.00 respectively.
Paris positions were also lower, with October off 50 cents at $348.50 and December down $3.00 at $343.00. Matif volume totalled 1,164 lots.
